findings.evidence: test_session_sweep_runs_the_seven_day_rule_daily_and_dry now asserts arguments.wet is True and retention.execute is True, and its docstring documents the arming, but the function name still says "and_dry"; the name no longer matches what the test asserts.

findings.evidence: The rewritten loop lines keep `python -m ... --wet && touch /tmp/brain-v42-session-sweep.heartbeat || echo "... run failed ..."`: if the python command succeeds but touch fails, the echo misreports the run as failed. Pre-existing pattern carried through the rewrite; cosmetic.
findings.title: touch failure would be logged as a failed sweep run
